aboutCollege.title: About Vaigai College
paragraphs: Vaigai College of Engineering (VCE) was established in 2012 under the Vaigai Educational Trust (VET), Madurai, with the vision of providing quality technical education and nurturing socially responsible global citizens. With a commitment to making quality technical education accessible to students from diverse backgrounds, the institution promotes inclusive and value-based education. Approved by the All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE), New Delhi, and affiliated with Anna University, Chennai, VCE is spread across a serene 15-acre campus that provides a conducive environment for learning.

The campus is equipped with well-designed academic and administrative facilities, including lecture halls, tutorial and drawing halls, an auditorium, library, computer centre, laboratories and spacious playgrounds. It also houses hostel facilities, a canteen and a training and placement cell to support students’ academic, professional and entrepreneurial development. Vaigai College strives to foster academic excellence, creativity, leadership, professional competence and social responsibility, inspiring young minds to become skilled, confident and responsible contributors to society.

body.text: The Department of Civil Engineering, in association with
RACE – Royal Association of Civil Engineering

, organized the Inauguration Ceremony of RACE – Royal Association of Civil Engineering on 21 July 2026 at ML-2. Dr. R. Sivaranjani, Principal (i/c), presided over the function. Dr. A. V. S. Santhosh Kumar, Dean/Admin, delivered the special address. Er. C. Kaliraj, Chief Guest, delivered the keynote address and spoke about recent trends and career opportunities in the civil engineering sector. Dr. N. Balaganesh, HOD/Civil, extended his support and guidance for the programme. All faculty members and students of the Civil Engineering Department actively participated in the ceremony.

galleryImages.caption: Chief Guest Er. C. Kaliraj delivering keynote address
Students and faculty at the inaugural session

events.title: Inaugural Function of Mechanical Engineers Student Association (MESA–2026)

body.text: The Department of Mechanical Engineering organized the Inaugural Function of the Mechanical Engineers Student Association (MESA–2026) on 19 August 2026 at the Dr. Abdul Kalam Auditorium from 11:00 a.m. to 12:45 p.m. Dr. R. Sivaranjani, Principal (i/c), delivered the presidential address. Dr. B. Sujatha, Dean/Academics, delivered the special address, while Dr. A. V. S. Santhosh Kumar, Dean/Admin, offered felicitations. The chief guest, Er. R. Senthil Kumar, Head – Business Development & Technical Trainer, delivered a guest lecture on "Design and 3D Printing Technology". Dr. S. Mohanasundaram, HOD/Mech, actively supported and guided the programme. All faculty members and students of the department participated in the event.

galleryImages.caption: Chief guest Er. R. Senthil Kumar addressing mechanical students

events.kicker: DEPARTMENT OF ELECTRONICS & COMMUNICATION ENGINEERING AND ELECTRICAL & ELECTRONICS ENGINEERING
events.title: Workshop on Embedded Systems and IoT

body.text: The Departments of Electronics and Communication Engineering (ECE) and Electrical and Electronics Engineering (EEE) jointly organized a One-Week Workshop on Embedded Systems and IoT from 27 July to 3 August 2026 at ML- 3. The programme was conducted by professional trainers from Enthu Technology Solutions India Pvt. Ltd., Coimbatore. Dr. R. Sivaranjani, Principal (i/c), presided over the function, with Dr. A. V. S. Santhosh Kumar, Dean/Admin, and Dr. B. Sujatha, Dean/Academics, offering felicitations. A total of
38 students
from the ECE and EEE departments actively participated and gained hands-on experience in Embedded Systems and IoT technologies.

galleryImages.caption: Students working on embedded development kits

body.text: The Faculty Development Cell (FDC) of Vaigai College of Engineering organized a Faculty Development Programme titled
“IIC & YOU: Building an Innovation Culture”

on 31 July 2026 at the Dr. Abdul Kalam Auditorium from 3:00 p.m. to 4:45 p.m. Dr. R. Sivaranjani, Principal (i/c), delivered the presidential address, while Dr. A. V. S. Santhosh Kumar, Dean/Admin, and Dr. B. Sujatha, Dean/Academics, offered felicitations. The resource person, Dr. G. S. Uthayakumar, Professor and President – IIC, Solamalai College of Engineering, Madurai, delivered a talk on fostering innovation, entrepreneurship and research culture among faculty members. Faculty members from various departments attended the programme.

events.kicker: YOUTH RED CROSS AND RED RIBBON CLUB
events.title: Health Awareness Programme

body.text: The Youth Red Cross (YRC) and Red Ribbon Club (RRC) organized a Health Awareness Programme on 27 July 2026 for students from all departments. Dr. M. Janaki, M.B.B.S., D.G.O., Medical Officer, Government Primary Health Centre, M. Puliyankulam, served as the chief guest and delivered an informative awareness lecture on youth health, nutrition and disease prevention. The programme was conducted under the leadership of Dr. R. Sivaranjani, Principal (i/c), with the support of Dr. A. V. S. Santhosh Kumar, Dean/Admin, and Dr. B. Sujatha, Dean/Academics. Students actively participated and interacted with the medical expert during the session.

galleryImages.caption: Dr. M. Janaki presenting health guidelines to students
Faculty felicitation of the chief guest

body.text: The National Service Scheme (NSS), Youth Red Cross (YRC), and Red Ribbon Club (RRC) organized a Blood Donation Camp on 31 July 2026 in collaboration with Meenakshi Mission Hospital, Madurai.
More than 50 students
and staff members voluntarily registered for the camp, and
40 units

of blood were collected. Dr. R. Sivaranjani, Principal (i/c), Dr. A. V. S. Santhosh Kumar, Dean/Admin, and Dr. B. Sujatha, Dean/Academics, congratulated the student volunteers and blood donors for their noble contribution to society.

events.title: State-Level Online Quiz Competition on HIV/STI Awareness

body.text: The Red Ribbon Club (RRC) organized the TNSACS Quiz Competition – 2026, a State-Level Online Quiz Competition, on 12 August 2026 under the Intensified IEC Campaign 3.0.
More than 140 students

participated in the competition, which focused on HIV/STI prevention, the HIV/AIDS (Prevention and Control) Act, 2017, and promoting healthy lifestyles among youth. Dr. R. Sivaranjani, Principal (i/c), along with Dr. A. V. S. Santhosh Kumar, Dean/Admin, and Dr. B. Sujatha, Dean/Academics, appreciated the participants for their active involvement in creating awareness on crucial health issues.

galleryImages.caption: Official poster: TNSACS State-Level Online Quiz Competition

events.title: Anti-Drug Awareness and Health & Wellness Programme

body.text: The VCE Anti-Drug Club organized a Mass Anti-Drug Pledge and Anti-Drug Awareness and Health & Wellness Programme on 11 August 2026 at the Dr. Kalam Auditorium with the theme
“Empowering Youth for a Healthy Future.”

As part of the initiative, an Online Drawing and Speech Competition was also conducted. The event was led by Dr. R. Sivaranjani, Principal (i/c), alongside Dr. A. V. S. Santhosh Kumar, Dean/Admin, and Dr. B. Sujatha, Dean/Academics. Nearly
250 students
and staff members took the pledge against substance abuse and participated in the awareness session.

galleryImages.caption: Students and staff taking the mass anti-drug pledge

events.title: Entrepreneurship, Innovation and Startup Awareness Programme

body.text: The Entrepreneurship Development Cell (EDC) organized an Entrepreneurship, Innovation and Startup Awareness Programme on 13 August 2026 for students from all departments. The resource person, Er. S. Vigneshwaran, Founder & CEO of TechStart Solutions, Madurai, guided students on ideation, business modeling and government startup funding opportunities. Dr. R. Sivaranjani, Principal (i/c), presided over the function, supported by Dr. A. V. S. Santhosh Kumar, Dean/Admin, and Dr. B. Sujatha, Dean/Academics. Students actively presented preliminary project ideas and received valuable expert feedback.

galleryImages.caption: Er. S. Vigneshwaran discussing startup opportunities

body.text: The National Service Scheme (NSS) organized the 78th Independence Day Celebration on 15 August 2026 with the participation of students from all departments. Dr. R. Sivaranjani, Professor/ECE and Principal (i/c), Vaigai College of Engineering, hoisted the National Flag and delivered the Independence Day address, inspiring students to contribute to nation-building and uphold ethical values. Dr. A. V. S. Santhosh Kumar, Dean/Admin, and Dr. B. Sujatha, Dean/Academics, graced the occasion. Patriotic songs and cultural performances marked the celebration.

Vaigai CollegeofEngineering proudly representsour Anna University Rank Holders.
Ms. P. Snowfia, CSE department (2021-2025 batch) and Mr. S.A. Arunprasath, Mechanical department (2021-2025 Batch)

events.title: Expert Talk on “Success Is a Skill: Habits of High Performers”

body.text: Vaigai College of Engineering organized an Expert Talk on
“Success Is a Skill: Habits of High Performers”

on 8 July 2026 from 2:30 p.m. to 4:00 p.m. at the Dr. Abdul Kalam Auditorium. Dr. B. Sujatha, Dean/Academics, Vaigai College of Engineering, served as the resource person and delivered an inspiring session on cultivating high-performance habits, self-discipline and professional excellence. Dr. R. Sivaranjani, Principal (i/c), presided over the programme. Students actively participated and interacted during the session.

The Training and Placement Cell (TPC) organized an On-Campus Recruitment Drive on 10 August 2026 for final-year CSE and ECE students. Beasant Technologies conducted the recruitment process and assessed the candidates through technical and HR interview rounds. Dr. R. Sivaranjani, Principal (i/c), along with Dr. A. V. S. Santhosh Kumar, Dean/Admin, and Dr. B. Sujatha, Dean/Academics, supported and encouraged the students throughout the placement process.
Vaigai college of Engineering proudly announces that
16 students
from the departments of CSE, ECE & EEE has been selected for JOB-READY INTERNSHIP & PLACEMENT PROGRAM (JRIP) by QSpiders, a leading software training organization, during the academic year 2026-2027.

A Pooled Campus Recruitment Drive was organized by the Training and Placement Cell (TPC) jointly with INOVONZ ENGINEERICS on 18 August 2026 for IV year EEE students. The drive provided students with an opportunity to showcase their technical skills and explore core industry placement opportunities. Dr. R. Sivaranjani, Principal (i/c), Dean/Admin, and Dean/Academics supported and congratulated the participants.

An Off-Campus Recruitment Drive was organized by the Training and Placement Cell (TPC) on 19 August 2026 for IV year CSE students. Newrta Solutions Pvt. Ltd. conducted the recruitment process and provided eligible students with an opportunity to pursue career opportunities in the software development domain. Dr. R. Sivaranjani, Principal (i/c), and the college leadership supported the initiative.

Selected student
Mr. S. Maadhesh
NEWRTA SOULTIONS Pvt Ltd as Software Developer.

The Training and Placement Cell (TPC) organized TACT – Level 1 on 20 August 2026 for IV year students. Dr. R. Sivaranjani, Principal (i/c), along with the Heads of Departments, supported and guided the programme. The initiative focused on enhancing students’ aptitude, technical competencies and career readiness through structured training sessions.
